# MLOps Experiment 9: CI Pipeline

## Objective
To automate model building, testing and validation using GitHub Actions.

## Tools Used
- Python
- Scikit-learn
- Pytest
- GitHub Actions

## Workflow
1. Checkout the GitHub repository.
2. Set up Python environment.
3. Install required libraries.
4. Train the Logistic Regression model.
5. Execute automated tests using Pytest.
6. Generate and upload the model report.

## Result
The CI pipeline automates model training and testing.
The model report is generated and uploaded as a build artifact.
